question: Krishna III of Rashtrakuta dynasty established a victory pillar and a temple at which of the following cities of south India after defeating the Chola ruler Parantaka I?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rameswaram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Krishna III of the Rashtrakuta dynasty established a victory pillar and a temple at **Rameswaram** after defeating the Chola ruler Parantaka I.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement in the Rashtrakuta-Chola conflicts and showcased the military prowess of Krishna III.
